title: Independent verification of large claim sets (claims.js, fact-auditor, Q.claim_supported)

sources.locator: user request 2026-11-24: work across hundreds to thousands of screens cannot be checked by hand; a separate agent or script must verify it, not the producer
user decision 2026-11-24: claims ledger, premise ledger, clean-room verifier, evidence grade, canaries, human audit of the auditor; Jev is used; pilot on the 11 accounting draft flows
user decision 2026-11-24: verify any report to the user whose facts need a reliability check (web research, analysis, comparison), not only bulk work; run with or without /plan; a skill may start it
user decision 2026-11-24: a human sample on every bulk run is too much work; default to evidence re-run and better canaries, ask for a human sample only when needed

verify-before-report behavior check 2026-11-27, external run 3: recheck gave not_rerunnable for all 10 web items; fact-auditor returned check-verifiers fail (one compound Bash call refused) and next_action rerun, and the orchestrator scored and reported anyway
